name: Iron Sword
description: A sturdy iron blade. Slightly increases Attack.

name: Battle Axe
description: A heavy two-handed axe. Considerably increases Attack.

name: Magic Staff
description: A staff imbued with arcane energy. Considerably increases Magic.

name: Shadow Dagger
description: A slim blade tipped with dark residue. Increases Attack and Magic.

name: Enchanted Wand
description: A slender wand crackling with stored energy. Increases Magic.

name: Leather Vest
description: Light but dependable protection. Slightly increases Defense.

name: Chain Mail
description: Interlocked iron rings that provide solid protection.

name: Arcane Robe
description: A flowing robe woven with mana threads. Increases Defense and Mana.

name: Iron Shield
description: A reinforced shield that can absorb heavy blows.

name: Dragon Scale Armor
description: Forged from a dragon's shed scales. Greatly increases Defense and Health.

name: Amulet of Vitality
description: A glowing amulet that bolsters the wearer's constitution.

name: Ring of Power
description: A ring pulsing with raw energy. Increases both Attack and Magic.

name: Mana Crystal
description: A shard of crystallized mana. Considerably increases maximum Mana.

name: Iron Pendant
description: A simple iron pendant worn by veteran warriors. Increases Defense and Attack.

name: Health Potion
description: A vial of red liquid. Restores 30 HP when consumed.

name: Greater Health Potion
description: A concentrated healing draught. Restores 65 HP when consumed.

name: Mana Potion
description: A vial of blue liquid. Restores 30 MP when consumed.

name: Elixir
description: A shimmering blend of health and mana tonics. Restores 25 HP and 25 MP.

name: Inferno Core
description: A smouldering gem torn from a dragon's chest. Greatly increases Attack and Magic.

name: Minotaur Horn
description: A massive horn from a defeated Minotaur, still radiating raw ferocity. Greatly increases Attack and Health.

name: Giant's Sigil
description: A stone medallion etched with runes of immense strength. Greatly increases Health and Attack.
